newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ trade balance trend keeps falling in March.
newsitem.headline: NZ trade balance trend keeps falling in March.

text.p: New Zealand's trade balance for March quarter was in surplus to the value of $26.8 million, Statistics New Zealand (SNZ) said on Thursday.
This compared with a deficit of $214.8 million in the December quarter and a deficit of $6.3 million in the March 1996 quarter.

Valued at $4.88 billion, unadjusted exports for the quarter ended March 1997 were down by $119 million from the year ago quarter. Unadjusted imports for the March quarter were down by $152 million to a value of $4.85 billion.
